Transaction support

For an existing Augmont transaction, use the support route provided in your transaction account. Keep your transaction reference ready. Never share OTPs, payment credentials or passwords.

Frequently asked questions

What is Dhanvoraa?+

Dhanvoraa is a Gold and Silver savings platform designed to help users start with small amounts, save once or regularly, track their holdings and build towards personal goals.

How does digital gold or silver saving work?+

Choose a metal and purchase amount in the Augmont flow. Review the applicable price, quantity, taxes and charges before payment. Track your purchased holdings through the provided platform.

How can I start saving?+

Select Start saving to open the Augmont demo in a new tab. The demo link will be replaced with the final transaction experience when it is ready.

What is the minimum amount?+

The applicable minimum and maximum amounts are shown in the Augmont transaction flow. Confirm the current limits before you purchase.

Can I sell, redeem, or request physical delivery?+

Use the options supported by Augmont for your account. Availability, minimum quantities, delivery or making charges, serviceable locations and processing timelines are subject to its current terms.

What charges and taxes apply?+

Review the current buy price, applicable taxes, fees and final quantity in the transaction flow before confirming. Buy and sell prices can differ.

Can I save regularly?+

Recurring purchases depend on the options available in the Augmont flow. Check supported intervals, payment instructions, and pause or cancellation rules before setting one up.

Who provides the transaction service?+

Transactions are handled through the separate Augmont experience. Dhanvoraa is the brand and education website. Start saving currently opens the supplied Augmont demo.
